    Employment: Full-time
    Work Format: Remote

    About the Company

    We are a technology startup operating in the Data Infrastructure and Cloud Analytics domain. We are developing a platform that helps companies optimize analytical query execution by automatically selecting the most efficient database or query engine based on speed, cost, and performance.

    Our product brings together modern database technologies, cloud platforms, and distributed systems to make large-scale data processing faster and more efficient.

    About the Role

    We are looking for a Backend / Data Infrastructure Engineer to join the development of our product's core architecture.

    You will work at the intersection of Backend Development, Database Technologies, and Distributed Systems, building solutions that integrate different data processing systems and optimize analytical query execution.

    This role is a good fit for an engineer who is interested not only in traditional data processing workflows but also in database internals, query architecture, and distributed infrastructure.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs for interacting with different databases and query engines.
    • Build and improve integrations with Snowflake, DuckDB, Trino, ClickHouse, BigQuery, and other systems.
    • Develop mechanisms for SQL query routing, execution, and optimization across different query engines.
    • Work with SQL parsing, logical query plans, and SQL dialect transformations.
    • Ensure data consistency and result accuracy when executing queries across different systems.
    • Work with data storage technologies, including Apache Iceberg.
    • Develop automated benchmarking tools to test and compare different query engines in terms of execution speed, throughput, and cost.
    • Improve the platform's reliability, scalability, and performance.

    Requirements

    • Practical experience in Software Engineering or Backend Development.
    • Commercial development experience with Python; experience with Rust is also a plus.
    • Experience working with databases, data warehouses, or analytical platforms.
    • Understanding of SQL and database architecture.
    • Hands-on experience with distributed systems.
    • Understanding of SQL query optimization principles and database performance tuning.
    • Understanding of ETL processes and data modeling.
    • Experience developing APIs, integrations, or connectors for working with different systems.

    Nice to Have

    • Experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, DuckDB, Trino, or ClickHouse.
    • Experience with SQLGlot, Apache Calcite, Substrait, or SQL parsers.
    • Understanding of Query Federation, Query Routing, and Query Pushdown.
    • Experience with JDBC/ODBC, database connectors, or data migration between different systems.
    • Knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
    • Experience with data consistency validation and cross-database result comparison.
    • Contributions to open-source projects in the Data Infrastructure domain.
    • Experience working in early-stage startups.

    📋 Role Overview

    We’re looking for a Lead Python Engineer to join our team and support one of our US-based clients — a CRM and data intelligence platform for private-market investors.

    You’ll run backend, data and AI as one function: lead a team of seven engineers who build the core platform, the data pipelines and the AI services, and set the technical direction for all three. You’ll report to the client’s VP of Engineering and work alongside the frontend, QA and DevOps leads. This is a hands-on leadership role — about half of your week will be technical work.

    This is a full-time, long-term engagement with working hours of approximately 14:00–23:00 Kyiv time to overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours. Occasional out-of-hours incidents come with the role.

     

    🧙‍♂️In this role, you will

    • Lead a team of seven backend, data and AI engineers across several time zones and own their planning, growth and delivery.
    • Merge backend and AI into one team with a single planning process, cross-train both sides, make AI delivery visible alongside everything else and grow an owner for each area.
    • Write design docs, make architecture calls, take on the hardest problems and take the first page when backend or AI breaks in production.
    • Own the backend platform architecture, database design and technology choices, pay down tech debt deliberately, and keep the platform reliable as customers and their data grow.
    • Define the canonical company model — how companies are identified and related, including entity resolution and search — and make sure customers can trust where every piece of data comes from.
    • Own enrichment pipelines and data partners for company, people and deal data, and catch quality gaps before customers do.
    • Put evaluation and quality controls around AI features so models and prompts can change safely, and own their accuracy, speed and cost.
    • Review tickets before they reach engineers, hold code review to a real standard and track defects per feature.
    • Make the engineering call on backend and AI incidents, drive blameless postmortems and keep a short, ranked tech-debt register tied to the roadmap.
    • Agree API contracts with frontend, shape scope with Product and explain the data layer clearly to customers and their security teams.

     

     

    🎯You may be interested if

    • You want to own the core of a product end to end — backend, data and AI.
    • You are a hands-on leader who still enjoys building, not only managing.
    • You make decisions, write them down and see them through — and can disagree with a proposal without stalling it.
    • You’d rather build engineering practices that stick than inherit them, without slowing the team down.
    • You enjoy working with messy, real-world data and making it trustworthy.
    • You thrive in a remote work setup and appreciate autonomy in organizing your work.

     

     

    👌 Role Requirements

    • 8+ years of professional backend development experience with Python, including deep Django and PostgreSQL experience.
    • Strong relational data modeling and a record of sound architecture and technology choices on multi-tenant SaaS.
    • 2+ years leading teams of 7+ engineers, with a record of growing people into owners.
    • Experience leading distributed teams across time zones, including engineers from engineering partners.
    • Hands-on experience shipping LLM features to real users (retrieval, extraction or agent workflows) and measuring them with evaluation sets.
    • Hands-on experience with entity resolution, record linkage or pipelines that reconcile conflicting data sources; clear understanding of data provenance.
    • Experience owning production incidents and on-call in your area.
    • Experience in a company with established engineering processes: you know which practices are worth keeping and can build them without slowing the team down.
    • Experience using AI-powered development tools, particularly Claude Code or similar coding agents, as part of the development workflow.
    • Clear communication: writing design docs and decisions for engineers, explaining trade-offs to product managers and walking customers and non-technical stakeholders through how the system works.
    • Advanced English (C1) or higher, including confident spoken and written communication.

     

     

    Nice to have:

    • Familiarity with private equity, venture or company data from sources like PitchBook or Crunchbase.
    • Experience building and running production systems on Azure.
    • Experience building search that blends keyword and semantic retrieval across large datasets.
    • Experience with event streaming or orchestration (Kafka, Airflow) and data quality tooling (Great Expectations, Monte Carlo).
    • Experience with Python AI frameworks, agent tooling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
    • Experience building email or calendar integrations at scale.

     

     

    💻 Working Conditions

    • Employment Type: Full-Time 
    • This is a fully remote position with the entire team across Ukraine.
    • Preferred working hours: approximately 14:00–23:00 (Kyiv time), aligned with U.S. Eastern business hours.
    • 20 working days of paid vacation per year.
    • Financial compensation for completing certifications and encouraging continuous learning and professional development.
    • High-impact role with clear visibility — you’ll own the backend, data and AI layer of the product end to end.

    Who We Are

    Adaptiq is a technology hub specializing in building, scaling, and supporting R&D teams for high-end, fast-growing product companies in a wide range of industries.
     

    About the Opportunity

    Our client is an international product company focused on advancing its technology platform and building innovative, scalable solutions.

    The platform brings together multiple interconnected services, requiring robust architecture, seamless integrations, and efficient data processing. The engineering team tackles complex backend challenges, enhances existing functionality, and develops new capabilities while maintaining high standards of performance and reliability.

    The company fosters a collaborative, ownership-driven engineering culture and actively integrates AI-powered technologies to streamline development and support ongoing product innovation.
     

    About the Role

    We are looking for a skilled Senior Python Engineer to join an international product development team.

    In this hands-on role, you will design, build, and maintain backend services, enhance existing functionality, and develop new product features using Python, modern frameworks, cloud technologies, and distributed systems.

    You will have the opportunity to influence architectural decisions, participate in technical discussions, and take ownership of solutions from design to production.

    A key part of this role is the active use of AI-assisted development tools and coding agents. We are looking for someone who already uses these technologies extensively in daily development to accelerate delivery, solve engineering challenges, and maintain high code quality.

    While the main focus is backend engineering, we value a flexible mindset and a willingness to occasionally contribute to frontend or infrastructure-related tasks.
     

    Key Responsibilities

    • Design, develop, and maintain scalable Python backend services and FastAPI-based microservices.
    • Build and enhance APIs, internal service communication, and external integrations.
    • Optimize distributed systems, asynchronous messaging, and data processing workflows.
    • Participate in architecture discussions, technical reviews, and feature development.
    • Develop and support AI-powered functionality, including LLM integrations and prompt-based workflows when applicable.
    • Ensure high standards of performance, scalability, testing, observability, and reliability.
    • Troubleshoot production issues, resolve defects, and improve existing services.
    • Collaborate across teams and repositories to deliver complex technical solutions.
    • Integrate AI-powered coding tools into daily development and help shape best practices for their effective use.
       

    Required Skills & Experience

    • 5+ years of professional Python backend development experience.
    • Strong knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
    • Proven experience building enterprise-level web services with FastAPI, Django, or similar Python frameworks.
    • Hands-on experience designing APIs, building integrations, and implementing service-to-service communication.
    • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies, such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or equivalent solutions.
    • Practical experience developing, deploying, and maintaining cloud applications using AWS and its managed services.
    • Experience with Docker and containerized environments.
    • Strong practical experience with AI coding tools and agents, actively used as part of everyday software development rather than occasional assistance.
    • Ability to work independently, make technical decisions, and take full ownership of features from design to delivery.
    • Excellent English communication skills.
       

    Nice to Have

    • Experience integrating LLMs, AI models, or AI-powered features into production applications.
    • Familiarity with Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and modern deployment workflows.
    • Experience building data-intensive applications and processing large volumes of information.
    • Frontend development experience, particularly with Angular.
    • Exposure to cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, or platform engineering.
    • Previous technical leadership experience or an interest in growing into a leadership role.
       

    Why Join Us?

    • 20 days of paid vacation annually, plus official public holidays in your country of residence.
    • Full accounting and legal support in all countries where we operate.
    • Fully remote work with a powerful workstation and access to a co-working space if needed.

    Its platform lets banks and lenders work with retailer and telco data without raw personal data ever changing hands. The main goal is to help people with no credit history get access to credit.

     

    Your purpose in this role is to lead the move of legacy SQL Server / Azure Synapse pipelines onto open-source Apache Spark and Delta Lake. You'll write production software, not notebook scripts.

     

    Logistics

    • Location: fully remote, Europe 
    • Working hours: South Africa time zone (UTC+2, the same as Kyiv and one hour ahead of Warsaw). Senior leadership is on US Eastern time.
    • Employment: full-time. Contract type (B2B or permanent) and salary band to be confirmed.

    • Level: Mid-Senior, about 4–8 years of experience

       

    What you'll do

    • Rebuild legacy T-SQL stored-procedure logic as typed, tested PySpark pipelines
    • Prove that the new pipelines match the legacy outputs
    • Build FastAPI services that run and report on pipeline jobs
    • Add provider-neutral LLM features (local and hosted models) to the data workflows
    • Work in a spec-first codebase: design docs and ADRs, with tests and documentation shipped alongside every change

     

    Core stack

    Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, FastAPI, pytest, Docker, T-SQL, LLM integration

     

    Requirements

    • Python as your primary production language: modern typed Python (3.10+, ideally 3.12), with type hints that pass pyright or mypy, and Pydantic models
    • 2+ years running production Apache Spark / PySpark pipelines, using the DataFrame API and Spark SQL, partitioning and performance tuning, and with a solid grasp of the driver/executor architecture
    • Maintainable, tested code (pytest), with tooling such as uv or Poetry and a CLI framework such as Click
    • Based in Europe or South Africa and happy to work UTC+2 hours

     

    Strong advantages

    • Experience migrating SQL Server / Synapse / stored-procedure logic to Spark and proving output parity with the legacy system
    • Open-source or self-managed Spark (Spark on Kubernetes, EMR, Dataproc, Spark Connect), not only Databricks notebooks; Hive Metastore, Trino, Apache Ranger
    • FastAPI services with request validation, HMAC-signed auth, idempotency and job-status semantics
    • LLM features: prompt construction, structured-output validation, local models (Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp), evaluation and guardrails
    • Privacy engineering: PII tokenisation and hashing, k-anonymity, GDPR/POPIA, multi-tenant isolation
    • Fintech, banking, credit-bureau, adtech-measurement or retail-data background
    • Observability: structlog, OpenTelemetry, OpenLineage
    • Azure (ADLS, Synapse) and a Databricks Certified Spark Developer credential

    Понад 1000 клієнтів у більш ніж 80 країнах вже переконалися в здатності Precoro створювати реальну бізнес-цінність і забезпечувати суттєву економію коштів.
     

    Ми шукаємо Python Developer, який візьме на себе Python-логіку Precoro у трьох зонах: Reports, Imports і Payments. Наш ідеальний кандидат шукає нові виклики, сильну команду та можливість зробити свій вклад в продукт, який несе цінність клієнтам по всьому світу.

     

    Що ти робитимеш:

    • Reports - кастомні та предналаштовані репорти, експорти, дані для дашбордів, RFP-репорти.
    • Imports - імпорти та оновлення файлом (айтеми й каталог, DCF/ICF, постачальники, документи), а також мікросервіс імпортів.
    • Payments - уся Python-логіка модуля Payments & Virtual Cards: репорти, мікросервіси, імпорти, AI-функціональність, інтеграції зі Stripe, корпоративні картки та платежі.

       

    Твої задачі включатимуть:

    • Розробку нового функціоналу для модулів Reports, Imports і Payments
    • Розвиток мікросервісу імпортів та оптимізацію імпортів/експортів
    • Підтримку та розвиток інтеграцій зі Stripe
    • Написання якісного коду, який легко підтримувати та розвивати
    • Участь у технічних обговореннях та пошуку оптимальних рішень разом із командою
       

    Ми шукаємо людину, яка:

    • Має 1-3 роки досвіду розробки на Python
    • Добре розуміє OOP, типізацію та принципи clean code
    • Має досвід роботи з background jobs та чергами повідомлень (Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ)
    • Має досвід роботи з Flask або подібними фреймворками
    • Володіє SQL на практичному рівні
    • Працювала з REST API, Docker та Git
    • Вміє працювати з існуючою кодовою базою, пропонує покращення та бере відповідальність за свої рішення.


    Буде плюсом:

    • Досвід роботи зі сторонніми інтеграціями
    • Знання Swagger/OpenAPI
    • Базове розуміння PHP (Symfony)
       

    Якщо це про тебе — чекаємо на твій відгук!

     

    Що ми пропонуємо:

    • Довіра — база: Без мікроменеджменту — ми цінуємо твої ідеї та ініціативи.
    • Культура команди: Ти ніколи не залишишся сам на сам — наша команда відкрита, чесна та завжди готова допомогти.
    • Компенсація професійного розвитку: Ми інвестуємо у твій ріст через курси, лекції та інші можливості навчання.
    • 26 днів відпочинку щороку (15 днів відпустки + 11 державних свят): Ми дбаємо про баланс між роботою та особистим життям.
    • Медичне страхування (після шести місяців) та необмежена кількість лікарняних без медичних довідок: Здоров’я — пріоритет.
    • Pet-friendly офіс у Києві: Любиш свого пухнастого друга? Бери його з собою на роботу!
    • Підтримка України: Ми активно допомагаємо Збройним Силам та долучаємося до проєктів, які наближають нашу перемогу.


    Наш процес найму прозорий та швидкий:

    • Скрінінг резюме (Ми уважно розглядаємо всі резюме, але зв’яжемося лише з релевантними кандидатами)
    • Зустріч з рекрутером (45 хв)
    • Технічна співбесіда з наймаючим менеджером (1 година)
       

    Приєднуйся до команди, яка цінує довіру, прозорість і відкриту комунікацію!

    We're looking for a mid-to-senior Platform Engineer to join an early-stage AI company in Stockholm. The company builds agentic AI for intellectual property and legal teams, and its platform serves Fortune 500 customers with long-running, document-heavy workloads. The purpose of the hire is to own the Kubernetes platform underneath the product. As concurrent agent sessions grow from hundreds to thousands, you'll keep the infrastructure fast, secure and resilient. We want a software engineer at heart who builds the platform as code and cares about reliability, performance and cost.

     

    Role at a glance

    • Location: Stockholm, Sweden (on-site)
    • Employment: Full-time
    • Seniority: Mid-Senior
    • Core stack: Kubernetes, Azure, Terraform / Infrastructure as Code, TypeScript, Python, distributed systems

     

    What you'll do

    • Own and evolve the Kubernetes platform for heavy, long-running workloads
    • Design and scale distributed systems that handle unpredictable load
    • Build the services that run the platform, in TypeScript and/or Python
    • Automate infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code
    • Balance reliability, performance and cost with a product mindset

     

    Must have

    • Deep expertise in Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure
    • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience (e.g. Terraform)
    • Strong software engineering background, with production experience in TypeScript and/or Python
    • A proven track record of designing and scaling distributed systems in production

     

    Nice to have

    • Experience running AI or inference-heavy workloads at scale
    • Experience with enterprise security, compliance and data residency
    • Direct experience with Azure and Terraform

     

    Process

    1. Short intro call with me
    2. Technical and experience-based conversation
    3. Further steps with the client
